name: get_email_stats
description: Aggregate statistics for emails matching a Gmail query. Returns total count, first/last received timestamps, date span, average per day, unique sender breakdown with counts and percentages, unique thread count, and subject samples. Uses header-only fetches — no email body is downloaded. Use Gmail query syntax to filter by sender, date, label, etc.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Gmail query string. Examples: "from:alice@example.com", "from:alice@example.com after:1735689600", "from:alice@example.com newer_than:90d", "label:inbox from:boss@work.com".

inputs.name: max_results
inputs.description: Max emails to count (default 5000, max 50000). Sender/date breakdowns are based on a sample of 500 most recent — the total count is always exact.

inputs.name: group_by_sender
inputs.description: Include per-sender breakdown in results (default true).

inputs.name: group_by_day
inputs.description: Include daily count distribution in results (default false). Useful for visualising send frequency over time.

inputs.name: top_senders_limit
inputs.description: How many top senders to return in the breakdown (default 10).

outputs.description: Human-readable summary: total, date range, top sender, thread count.
ISO 8601 UTC datetime of the oldest matched email.
ISO 8601 UTC datetime of the most recent matched email.
Days between first and last received email.
Average emails per day over the span.
Number of distinct Gmail thread IDs.
Top sender breakdown: [{email, count, pct, subject_samples}].
Daily count distribution [{date, count}] when group_by_day=true.
Up to 10 subject lines from matched emails.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments are:
query (required): Gmail query string. Examples:
  - "from:alice@example.com" — all mail from Alice
  - "from:alice@example.com newer_than:90d" — last 90 days from Alice
  - "from:alice@example.com after:1735689600" — after unix timestamp
  - "label:inbox subject:invoice" — inbox invoices
max_results: int, default 5000, max 50000. Controls how many IDs are counted. Sender/date breakdowns are always based on a 500-message sample; the total count is exact.
group_by_sender: true/false (default true) — include sender breakdown.
group_by_day: true/false (default false) — include daily count distribution.
top_senders_limit: int (default 10) — how many senders to return.
account_id: optional, default "google_user_primary".

metadata.planner_description: Count emails and break down by sender/date for a Gmail query. Fast, header-only.
